feeds.what: every state-level and multi-locality contest of the election in one document (32 ballot items: US Senate, 11 US House, 3 constitutional amendment questions, one House of Delegates special, and 16 town/shared local offices), plus 133 locality election stubs with precinct progress, turnout statistics and voter registration
feeds.notes: Standard Enhanced Voting shape: …/results/public/api/elections/<slug>/<publicElectionId>/data. slug 'virginia' (jurisdiction.shortName, lower case; 'Virginia' in the elections-list guess 404'd but that path is wrong anyway). 106,836 bytes gzipped. Cache-Control: public, max-age=<60 counting down> (Akamai in front). Text fields are arrays with four languages (en, '1' Spanish, '2' Korean, '5' Vietnamese): pick languageId 'en', not index 0 blindly (en is first here). Contests wholly inside one locality (most local offices) are not in this file; they live in the locality's own election.

feeds.what: jurisdiction document with the elections list (32 elections) and the 133 localities
feeds.notes: I fetched it as …/api/jurisdictions/Virginia (capital V) and got 200 with shortName 'virginia', so the slug is case-insensitive at least here. Elections list is .elections[].

election_id: '2026-November-General' (publicElectionId). In the page URL /results/public/virginia/elections/2026-November-General and the API URL /api/elections/virginia/2026-November-General/data. Internal GUID election.id = 01000000-ebdd-00dc-0143-08df1fee4ade.
discovery: GET https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/virginia and read .elections[] (publicElectionId, electionDate, name). Virginia runs many elections a year (specials: '2026-April-21-Special', party primaries as two separate elections '2026-August-Republican-Primary' / '2026-August-Democratic-Primary'), so match on electionDate and name rather than building the id.
cors: none on 200 responses (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin; 'cross-origin-resource-policy: same-origin'). The 404 for the wrong list path did carry 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *'. Needs the relay.
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 200 for jurisdictions and data (Akamai CDN, Server-Timing ak_p; no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried. https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/ itself redirects to https://www.elections.virginia.gov/results/ (the department's landing page), also 200.
updated_field: election.asOf = '2026-11-10T23:10:33.124623Z' (UTC). Also election.lastUpdated = '2026-11-10T23:09:50.0837474Z', election.publishDate, election.publishVersionId. Repeated per contest in ballotItems[].reportingStatus.asOf. It was republishing roughly every few minutes a week after the election (asOf was under 4 minutes old when fetched).
reporting_field: Per contest: ballotItems[].reportingStatus.reportingUnits / .totalUnits where the units are LOCALITIES (counties and independent cities): {"reportingUnits": 133, "totalUnits": 133} for US Senate, 18/18 for the 1st congressional district. Precinct progress exists only per locality: localityElections[].precinctsReporting (a 0..1 fraction, e.g. 1.0), localityElections[].precinctReportingStatus [{groupName 'Fully Reported', value 8}, {'Partially Reported', …}], and jurisdiction.childLocalities[].percentReporting / precinctsReporting. election.totalVoters = 6513546.0; election.ballotsCast is 0.0 at state level (localities have their own, e.g. 6677.0).

state_lower: Member, House of Delegates (20th District) (a special election; the only legislative contest, since Virginia elects its legislature in odd years)

choice_format: ballotItems[].summaryResults.ballotOptions[]: name [{"languageId":"en","text":"Mark R. Warner"}, …3 more languages], voteCount 2216084, party {abbreviation:"D", name:[{"languageId":"en","text":"Democratic"}, …]} (single-letter abbreviations D, R). Nicknames are in straight double quotes inside the name: 'Robert J. "Rob" Wittman'. Write-ins are one option 'Write-In' with isWriteIn true and null party. Measures: contestType 'BallotMeasure', options 'Yes' and 'No'. isWinner null throughout.
district_field: Only in the title, as an ordinal in parentheses: 'Member, House of Representatives (1st District)', 'Member, House of Delegates (20th District)'. Local items put the place in parentheses the same way ('Mayor - Farmville (Town of Farmville)'). contestGroupId is null for every item; voteFor is the instruction text 'Vote for only one'.
terms: none found on the results site or in the API. I did not search elections.virginia.gov for a general terms page.
